text:
**Deforestation cannot be confirmed.** The evidence supports approximately 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss on the 58.1 ha asset in 2023, or 1.2% of its area.

Of that loss, 0.4 ha was mapped as planted eucalyptus forest and 0.3 ha was outside the 2021 mapped forest area; none was mapped as native forest. Tree-cover loss can include plantation harvesting or other stand replacement, so it does not by itself establish deforestation or a change in land use.
